_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Get call
operations.description: Retrieve a call by its ID. - media_url is a presigned URL that expires in 24 hours

operations.name: Get media
operations.description: Retrieve a call's media URL and type by its ID. - media_url is a presigned URL that expires in 24 hours

operations.name: Get call snippets
operations.description: Retrieve a call's snippets by its ID. - snippets are sorted by created_at_utc in descending order (newest first) - media_url is a presigned URL that expires in 24 hours - transcript_turns are filtered to the snippet time range

operations.name: Get forecasting config
operations.description: Return public forecasting configuration for an API-key organization.

operations.name: Get playbook
operations.description: Retrieve a playbook by its ID, including the latest version's content.

operations.name: Get playbook version
operations.description: Retrieve a specific version of a playbook by its ID.

operations.name: Join call
operations.description: Join a call by creating a bot that will join the specified meeting URL. The bot will join the meeting and record it. Once the call is complete, it can be processed and retrieved through other API endpoints. Multiple bots cannot be created for the same meeting URL within 2 minutes.

meeting_url.description: The URL of the meeting to join (e.g., Google Meet, Zoom, etc.)

title.description: The title of the meeting to join

operations.name: List call tags
operations.description: Retrieve all call tags for your organization. Tags are sorted by creation time (oldest first).

operations.name: Get calls
operations.description: Retrieve list of calls for your organization. - Only public calls are returned (all private calls are excluded) - Results are sorted by start time in descending order (newest first)

participant_email.description: A participant's email to filter by (case insensitive). Only calls with this participant will be shown.

start_time_from.description: Filter calls starting from this time (UTC ISO 8601)

start_time_to.description: Filter calls starting up to this time (UTC ISO 8601)

title_filter.description: Query to filter calls by call title.

tag_ids.description: Filter calls by tag IDs. Only calls with at least one of the specified tags will be returned.

operations.name: List forecast submissions
operations.description: List historic forecast submissions for the API key's organization. Results include resubmissions and are ordered by submission time, newest first. Omit `user_id` to read the whole organization. Embedded deal snapshots are included only when `include_deals` is true; `deal_count` always describes the frozen snapshot size.

user_id.description: Filter to submissions by one or more Airspeed user IDs.

period.description: Filter to one exact period label from forecasting config.

board_id.description: Filter to one forecast board ID from forecasting config.

submitted_after.description: Include submissions posted at or after this UTC timestamp.

submitted_before.description: Include submissions posted at or before this UTC timestamp.

include_deals.description: Include each rep submission's frozen deal snapshot.

operations.name: List playbook versions
operations.description: List all versions for a playbook. - Results are sorted by created time in descending order (newest first).

operations.name: List playbooks
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of playbooks for your organization. - Results are sorted by playbook creation time in descending order (newest first). - `updated_at` reflects the latest version's update timestamp, falling back to its creation time, and finally to the playbook's own creation time when no version exists.
